description.value: Frontcountry campground on the Alaska Highway in Stone Mountain Park's remote northern Rockies, with dramatic mountain scenery and strong wildlife viewing; cash-only fees, seasonal gate closure (walk-in off-season only), and rapidly changing weather require preparation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM provides solid baseline data for this 28-pitch BC Parks frontcountry campground: drinking_water=yes, shower=no, toilets=yes, tents=yes, openfire=yes, and payment:cash=only. The BC Parks website confirms the campground exists as a frontcountry site in Stone Mountain Park along the Alaska Highway, and explicitly corroborates the cash-only OSM tag with the statement 'Camping fees must be paid in cash. Credit and debit cards are not accepted at this park.' No amenities beyond those in OSM tags (water, toilets, fire) are confirmed or denied on the website, and the website makes no mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, charging, or reservations specific to Summit Lake.
concerns: Cash payment only — no credit or debit cards accepted; touring cyclists should be aware and plan ahead.
No internet access (OSM internet_access=no); very remote location 140 km west of Fort Nelson.
OSM image tag points to an accessibility.bcparks.ca URL that was not fetched; additional accessibility details are unverified.
No address or phone number in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operational BC Parks campground on the Alaska Highway — one of the most heavily cycled long-distance touring routes in western Canada. Potable water, toilets, and fire pits confirmed; the remote location makes it a critical overnight stop for northbound and southbound tourers.
enrichment_extras.notes: The BC Parks frontcountry camping page notes that reservations are available at 110+ campgrounds province-wide, but does not specifically confirm or deny reservability for Summit Lake Campground. Verify via the BC Parks reservation system.

wow_evidence: frontcountry campground on the Alaska Highway in Stone Mountain Park... drinking_water=yes, toilets=yes, tents=yes
